fact: The PACAD programme paid 3,200 beneficiaries digitally through Orange Money in Berberati and planned to pay all 30,000 beneficiaries of its extension by mobile money, while LONDO paid wages in physically transported cash.
title: République Centrafricaine: Evaluation de l'Ecosystème des Paiements Numériques pour les Programmes de Transferts Monétaires des Filets de Protection Sociale
